transcript.description: The huddle transcript: Zoom VTT, Google Meet transcript text, or 'Speaker: text' lines. Required unless a prior recorder step supplies it (the skill then reads that output). Cited as input:transcript.

attendees.description: Who was in the huddle. A string's name is the part before ' ('. Owners come only from these names.

meeting_date.description: The huddle's date, YYYY-MM-DD. Absent: a date the transcript states, else null. Never taken from now.

meeting_title.description: The meeting's name, used in the page title.

team.description: Optional team name prefixed to the title, e.g. Growth.

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601, for report.meta only. Optional; never used to compute a date.
